notes: Actual OSM geometry. Zmuttbach contains four segments. Preserve gap at reservoir between [7.7025855,46.0079392] and [7.7096643,46.0078701]; do not fabricate connecting centerline. Glacier polygon is the OSM feature named Zmuttgletscher, not necessarily the full scientific glacier catchment and not a current glacier boundary survey. Heights must come from terrain, not invented river elevations. Context includes real Stausee Zmutt reservoir polygon, real dam line, Matterhorn summit point and Tiefmattengletscher tributary polygon. Do not render a direct summit-to-glacier river. Stream geometry is downstream valley hydrography; glacier is a mapped area with no implied current boundary accuracy.
